svg.title: About Sahajpreet Kaur
svg.desc: Editorial about section: introduction, core capabilities and an auto-advancing three-slide interests carousel.

g.text: I’m an aspiring software engineer and student developer from
Panchkula, Haryana. I enjoy turning ideas into working
applications, learning by building, and solving problems one
Exploring emerging technologies and AI, and
Building creative digital projects that turn ideas
one small experiment at a time.
